text:
Ana: Quick sync—need to decide what we cut from April milestone to protect MVP date. Options below.
Devon: Please list, thx.
Ana: Proposal: keep runtime, API, basic model-pinning by model_id (API + CLI), small console header showing pinned model; defer full pin-management UI, tag filters, and route-level long retention telemetry to v1.
Kai: Agree on minimal pin surface. Frontend work for a full UI is bigger than it looks; backend proto is ready.
Raj: Pilots care about fast rollback. Can we add a rollback endpoint and CLI wrapper so they can revert pins quickly without UI?
Devon: Yep — implement POST /pins/rollbacks and a tiny CLI. Cuts ~2 FE sprint-weeks.
Marie: If CLI first, include a tiny console header with current pinned model + link to CLI instructions so pilots don't get confused.
Ana: So final cutlist for MVP: remove full pin-management UI, advanced tag filters, route-level telemetry long retention, embeddings cache dashboard, and the full eval/regression alert suite. Keep: API, runtime, minimal pin API + CLI, header, canary toggle (simple), canary core, manual evals + alert webhook.
Kai: Embeddings eviction dashboard is nice-to-have; backend metrics via /metrics are fine for now.
Devon: Any paying pilot blocked by removing dashboards?
Raj: Two pilots asked for dashboards; both said "nice but not blocking." They prioritized rollback and predictable latency.
Marie: We should add an onboarding checklist in-console pointing to autoscale + routing policy docs—higher impact than cache dashboard. I'll draft copy.
Ana: Canary: keep basic canary rollout UI (toggle + % slider). Advanced rollout flows to v1.
Devon: Toggle is ~1 FE sprint; canary core exists in routing layer.
Kai: What about the "quality monitoring regression alerts tied to prompt sets"? Heavy infra.
Ana: Cut it from MVP. MVP: manual evals and a simple webhook alerts endpoint. Full eval suite in v1.
Devon: Estimates: CLI + header + toggle = 10 dev-days; rollback endpoint = 4 dev-days; canary safety tests = 6 dev-days. Total ~20 dev-days.
Kai: I'll validate rollback < 3min and canary fallback latency add < 500ms. Will run safety runbook tomorrow.
Raj: I'll notify pilots now and surface any pushback (pinging @acme_pilot and @greenleaf_pilot).
release-bot: FYI: milestone freeze in 9 business days. last build cutoff: 1763805400.
Ana: Action items: Devon — confirm estimates by EOD; Kai — validate SLAs; Marie — draft console header & CLI docs; Raj — notify pilots. I'll update milestone tracker and mark UI items for v1.
Marie: UX note—header must state "pinned models are global to tenant" explicitly.
Devon: Also log rollback audit trail (request_id + actor) for compliance — low effort, high value. Add to tasks.
Raj: thumbs up.
Kai: thumbs up.
Marie: :thumbsup: 
Devon: :shipit: 
Ana: Closing — I'll post updated milestone entry after tracker update.
